items.summary: CFO recommendation: keep financial containment. Do not approve new spend, revenue forecasts, ROI claims, or monetization expansion. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; $4.92 is aggregate and unattributed, so site revenue, contribution margin, CAC, ROI, and cost-to-learn are not calculable. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 57 improvements measuring and 108 approved proposals lacking execution. Complete or close the existing capacity-blocking repair case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z before admitting work.

AI spend is measurable only for the 2026-10-01 snapshot: $2.2785467 across 16 calls and 4 of 38 expected instrumented sites, averaging $0.14240916875 per call. This is not a cost-to-learn figure because no attributable revenue, incremental contribution, experiment outcome, or per-change cost exists. Treat the $2.2785467 as incurred AI operating spend, not evidence of return; do not extrapolate it fleet-wide.

Before any finance-sensitive implementation is admitted, complete or justifiably close the existing saveusfarms.com repair case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z. Record validation, rollback, release boundary, attribution limits, measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Do not add billing, tracking, spending, or production changes.

Preserve Amazon's $4.92 commission as aggregate unattributed revenue for 2026-09-21. Do not allocate the 629 aggregate clicks, 28 ordered items, or commission to any site. For future reporting, require a registered site tracking ID on every monetized link and retain ordered, shipped, commission, and reporting-period fields.

No owner approval is requested for spending or banking activity. The finance blocker is measurement completeness: contribution margin requires site-attributed commission plus direct AI, infrastructure, domain, vendor, and labor costs. Until those fields exist, approve no financial forecast or payback claim. Minimum additional measurement is a dated per-site cost ledger and revenue export; this is a reporting prerequisite, not authorization to spend.
